links.comparator_used: Llama3.1-8B without retrieval (base model, training knowledge alone); ChatGPT-4.0 also compared
links.outcome: Overall quality score of generated medication instructions, plus incorrect-use and hallucination frequency
links.effect: Overall median 79.9 (IQR 34.4) for Llama3.1-8B-RAG vs 66.5 (IQR 50.9) for Llama3.1-8B, post hoc P=.44. Incorrect-use instructions: 22.8% (n=19) in both. Hallucinations: 9.1% (n=6) with RAG vs 13.6% (n=9) without, chi-square P=.67 across models. RAG vs ChatGPT-4.0 overall P=.05.
links.tradeoff: Llama3.1-8B-RAG scored lower than ChatGPT-4.0 on language simplification (mean 5.44, SD 2.6 vs 7.05, SD 1.5; P<.001). RAG did not reduce incorrect-use instructions (22.8% in both).
links.quote: Llama3.1-8B-RAG received evaluations with similar overall scores to ChatGPT-4.0 (post hoc test, P=.05) and similar to Llama3.1-8B (post hoc test, P=.44).

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation grounding on patient information leaflets
